items.title: Hybrid DNS with Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver for private connections on AWS Cloud WAN
items.summary: Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver for private connections extends resilient, anycast DNS resolution to on-premises and branch-office clients privately over your existing AWS Cloud WAN network, with automatic multi-Region failover, per-segment DNS views, and centralized query logging, and without per-site configuration.
items.creator: Anandprasanna Gaitonde
